mainLiftTest.description: Add weight when every set reaches the top of the rep range at Solid effort or easier (RPE 8 or lower).

accessoryRule.description: Add reps up to the top of the range first, then the smallest weight jump for that equipment.

stall.description: Two consecutive sessions that fail the test: drop 10% and rebuild.
stall.message: Second miss in a row. Check sleep, food and ski load.

baseline.description: Week 1: work up to a set of 5 with 2 reps left on each main lift; train at about 90% of it for weeks 1-2. Clean: work up in doubles to a crisp, fast weight.

heavy.description: Main lifts move to 3-5 reps. First heavy-week target = last 4-6 target plus 5%, rounded to the increment (assumption, editable).

retest.description: Main lifts: work up to a 5-rep set at RPE 8-9. Also max strict pull-ups, max unbroken toes-to-bar, 5K time.

rampUp.description: Ramp-up sets before a main lift. Fractions of the target weight; empty bar first.

trim.description: Trim to fit, applied in order when the projected finish is past the cap. Cameron confirms before it applies.

timing.description: Set time = start-of-set seconds + reps x tempo (seconds per rep, from the exercise in plan.json), plus a margin. Setup seconds are added to the rest or transition before the first set of each exercise.
timing.confirmSetupDescription: v1.18: the countdown before the first set of each exercise waits for a 'Set-up done' tap instead of starting the set by itself (values: exercise, block, off). confirmWeightChange lists the equipment where a set whose weight differs from the set before it waits too (the bar has to be reloaded). confirmBeforeBlocks lists block types that wait for a 'Ready' tap before they start. A tap during a rest keeps the rest and only drops the set-up time added to it. The Settings toggle switches all of it off on the phone.
timing.gymClockDescription: v1.18: the clock in the workout header counts from Start to now and keeps running through a pause (time in the gym). Working time (what is compared with the plan) still leaves pauses out. If the app was closed for more than gymAwayMinutes and the session is then resumed, that gap is not gym time.
timing.sidesDescription: v1.18: holdSwitchSeconds is the change-over between the left and the right side of a hold or a stretch; stretchSwitchSeconds is the change-over into the next stretch; sideSwitchSeconds (above) is the change-over inside a set done one side at a time.

cues.note: v1.18 beeps. Each tone is [frequency Hz, start s, length s]. loud is the default voice: a square wave held at its level for the whole beep, through a low-pass filter so it stays a beep and not a buzz. Rendered side by side it is 12 to 18 dB louder than the old beeps, which were a sine wave that faded from the first instant. gain 0.8 is as high as it goes without clipping (the filtered square overshoots by about a fifth). normal is the old, softer voice; Settings > Loud beeps picks between them.

pacing.note: v1.18, Cameron Nov 20: adjust the time a set gets when he keeps ending it early or keeps needing more. A set counts as early when Done is tapped with at least max(earlySeconds, earlyFraction x the set's time) left for the reps he did; late when it was extended (+15 s), or paused for pausedLateSeconds or more and not ended early (a pause and an early Done is a break, not slow reps; at most pauseCapSeconds of a pause count). After inARow sets of an exercise in a row the same way, the seconds per rep become the slowest of those sets (plus cushion when shortening), kept between minFactor and maxFactor of the plan's tempo; within deadband of the tempo it goes back to the tempo. A lift with keepTempo in plan.json is never shortened. Ramp-up, baseline, retest, hold and all-out sets, sets typed in by hand and taps under minRepSeconds a rep are left out. Set-up time before an exercise's first set follows the time he takes until the Set-up done tap: after setup.inARow sessions in a row off by max(moreSeconds or lessSeconds, fraction x the allowed time) it becomes their average, between minSeconds and maxSeconds; of a pause during the set-up, at most setup.pauseCapSeconds count. Rest times are never changed here: they are part of the plan.

effortScale.description: The four effort buttons. Each stores an RPE number so the progression rules read the same as before.

startingEstimates.description: Rough first-session weights for free-weight accessories with no history, as a fraction of a main lift training weight or of bodyweight. Fractions for dumbbell lifts are per dumbbell; a lift marked pair in plan.json shows the total of both. Machines and cables are left blank because stacks differ. Shown as estimates; the first logged session replaces them.

dumbbellPairs.description: Exercises marked pair in plan.json use two dumbbells. Their weights are stored, shown and logged as the total of both; the weight jump is this many times the dumbbell jump so each hand moves one step.

review.description: End-of-session review: a set that was skipped, or is missing a weight or reps, is listed at the top and Save stays locked until each one is filled in or confirmed as skipped.

catchUp.note: Catch-up day: sets skipped or not reached in a saved session this week, plus whole lifts whose day passed with nothing logged. Nothing carries past the end of the week. Sets cut by Trim to fit and the if-time block are not owed.

runLog.note: Run types whose distance is not running miles. They still count as the planned run they replace.

runSchedule.note: v1.12: days a planned run can move to when its own day passes without it (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday). Lift days are never offered and lifts never move. Like catch-up sets, a run still open on Sunday night is dropped, not carried into next week.

garmin.note: Which Garmin activities become runs in the log. match is tested against Garmin's activity type (lower case). type null means a run: what it counts as is settled for the week by garmin.assign (v1.12). Shorter activities than minMinutes are left out. Location fields never leave Garmin's side: the job in the private repo drops them.

assign.note: v1.12: which planned run a Garmin run counts as, whatever day it was. Clear signs first: an interval-looking run takes the intervals, a run at least as long as this week's long-run target (or longMinutes) takes the long run. Then in date order: a planned run's own day, the intervals while open (intervalMinMinutes to intervalMaxMinutes), the long run if at least longOffDayShare of the target, otherwise Easy run. A type Cameron taps is never changed.

weekRings.note: v1.14 Home rings. Lifts: a saved session per plan lift this week. Runs: planned runs done (runs.js weekRuns). Hard efforts: the Engine finisher in engineSession plus the run with id hardRun.

numberCheck.note: v1.16, Cameron Nov 19: any number that doesn't make sense is flagged for him to review before it can move the plan. A work set is flagged when a barbell weight is under the empty bar (rampUp.barWeightLb), when the weight is at most lighterThan or at least heavierThan times its target and at least minGapLb away from it, when a weight with no target is over maxLb, when a dumbbell, machine or cable weight is under minLoadLb (0 included; v1.18), or when reps are more than max(2 x the top of the rep range, the top + extraReps). A set he confirms (numberOk) is never flagged again.

amrap.note: v1.19 (idea 7): on these main lifts, in these weeks, the last work set is all-out: at least the target reps, then as many good reps as he can, stopping when a rep slows right down or form slips (about 1 rep short of failure). The set does not end on its timer and its effort tap is left out of the main-lift test. Reserve at the top of the range = its reps + 1 - the top. Reserve of holdBelowReserve or less: the earlier Solid taps were optimistic, so the weight holds even if every set reached the top (no miss counted). Reserve of bigReserve or more: he is leaving reps in the tank, so the next target is the weight that set says he can lift for the top of the range with solidReserve reps left (from its e1RM), at least one increment and at most maxSteps increments up.
amrap.label: All-out set
amrap.stopWhen: Stop when a rep slows right down or your form slips.

knee.note: v1.19 (idea 1): a 0-10 knee pain score after the first work set of the first askAfter lift in a session, and on Home the day after a session with one of them. A score of swapAt or more swaps today's remaining sets (and, from a score within carryDays, the next session) to the fallbacks below, and holds those lifts' weights. Box squat and hang power clean are the plan's own knee swaps (plan.json cues); the box front squat applies the same idea to the front squat. Rating it again on the start page replaces the score.

back_squat.name: Box squat, 3-s lowering
back_squat.cue: Squat to a box at about parallel. Lower for 3 seconds, touch the box without relaxing, drive up. Same weight as the plan.
tips: Shins stay close to vertical; sit back to the box.
Stop the set if the knee gets sharper.

front_squat.name: Box front squat, 3-s lowering
front_squat.cue: Front squat to a box at about parallel. Lower for 3 seconds, touch the box, drive up. Same weight as the plan.
tips: Elbows high, sit back to the box.
Stop the set if the knee gets sharper.

power_clean.name: Hang power clean
power_clean.cue: Start from just above the knee and catch high. No deep catch today.
tips: Hips back to load the hang, then jump.
